items.summary_zh: 几十年来,加拿大一直被视为全球国防资金的落后者,而就在两年前,征兵情况十分严峻,以至于一位前国防部长警告了武装部队处于"死亡螺旋".

items.title: Steve Rosenberg: This year's Victory Day parade in Moscow felt very different
items.title_zh: 史蒂夫·罗森伯格:今年莫斯科的胜利日游行感觉非常不同
items.summary: I've attended many Victory Day parades on Red Square.
items.summary_zh: 我参加了许多在红广场上举行的胜利日游行.

items.title: Rosenberg: Scaled-back Victory Parade in Moscow's Red Square
items.title_zh: 罗森伯格:莫斯科红广场上规模化后卫胜利游行
items.summary: With fewer guests, fewer reporters, and no military hardware on display, Moscow's Victory Day parade was a much quieter affair than usual on Saturday.
items.summary_zh: 莫斯科的胜利节阅兵比平常更安静。

items.title: Anti-work anthems, Boy George and controversial lyrics: A guide to all 35 Eurovision songs
items.title_zh: 反工歌 Boy George和有争议歌词:所有35首欧视歌曲的指南
items.summary: Like a ray of sunshine on a cloudy day, the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest has arrived to dispel the gloom of a weary world.
items.summary_zh: 2026年欧洲影视歌唱大赛的到来,

items.title: Move over matcha. Hojicha is coming to a cafe near you
items.title_zh: 移动米卡。 霍吉查要来你附近的咖啡馆
items.summary: Browsing through the menu in a London cafe, Ana Costa wasn't sure what drink she was in the mood for. She didn't fancy a coffee and was considering a matcha latte, when hojicha caught her eye.
items.summary_zh: 在一家伦敦咖啡馆浏览菜单时,安娜·科斯塔(Ana Costa)不知道她心情如何饮用. 她不想要一杯咖啡 并且正在考虑一个火柴拿铁, 当Hojicha吸引了她的眼睛。

items.title: Return of IS-linked families sparks debate in terror-traumatised Australia
items.title_zh: 与IS有联系的家庭的返回在遭受恐怖创伤的澳大利亚引发了辩论
items.summary: After years spent detained in Syria, the freedom of the Islamic State group-linked families who landed back in their homeland of Australia this week was dramatically short lived.
items.summary_zh: 在叙利亚被关押多年后,本周登陆澳大利亚家园的与伊斯兰国集团有联系的家庭的自由生活极为短暂。

items.title: Return of Palestine Marathon attracts thousands of runners
items.title_zh: 巴勒斯坦马拉松的回归吸引了数千名跑者
items.summary: Thousands of people have taken part in the Palestine Marathon and Half Marathon which returned to the West Bank city of Bethlehem after a two-year pause because of restrictions over the Gaza War.
items.summary_zh: 数千人参加了巴勒斯坦马拉松和半马拉松,由于对加沙战争的限制,这两个城市在暂停两年后返回了西岸城市伯利恒。
